auditFocus: a controller action that builds a model from raw params without strong parameters (params.expect/params.require+permit), enabling mass assignment
raw SQL built with string interpolation instead of ActiveRecord parameterized conditions or sanitize_sql
a loop over an association that triggers N+1 queries because includes/preload/eager_load was not used
raw/html_safe applied to a value that can contain user input, bypassing ERB's automatic HTML escaping
a controller action reachable without before_action :authenticate_user! (or the app's equivalent) or an authorization check
an ActiveJob whose perform is not safe to run twice (no idempotency key or guard) on an adapter that can redeliver it -- true of most production Active Job adapters
a credential, API key, or signing secret committed in source instead of Rails credentials or ENV
buildCommands: bundle exec rspec (or bin/rails test, whichever the project uses)
bin/rails db:test:prepare (when a migration changed the schema)
bundle exec brakeman -q (only when the project has Brakeman configured)
fixGuardrails: Never add rubocop:disable to silence an offense instead of fixing the underlying code.
Never edit db/schema.rb by hand to make a migration pass; fix or add the migration and re-run it.
Never loosen strong parameters (e.g. permit!) or drop a before_action authentication/authorization filter just to make a failing request test pass.
Never delete or skip a failing test to reach a green build.
